purpose: Benchmark sentences for comparing zero-shot cloning against true adapted voice models.

items.text: This is a test of my personal voice model speaking naturally and clearly.
sarve maanavaah svatantraah samutpannaah vartante api cha
ātmā nityaḥ śuddhaḥ buddhaḥ muktaḥ svabhāvataḥ
सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः
The meaning of dharma, karma, and moksha should be spoken with correct Sanskrit pronunciation.
